verdict.rationale: Square publishes an official TypeScript/Node SDK in its own GitHub org, with documented client construction, typed resource methods such as `client.payments.create`, and per-call API version overrides. A Web Payments SDK is also listed in the docs. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages (Python, Java, Ruby, etc.), in-depth content on the Web Payments SDK beyond its title, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Square TypeScript library provides convenient access to the Square APIs from TypeScript.
